siteText.title: Airline Schedule Change Guide
siteText.subtitle: Select an airline to view its schedule-change threshold, rebooking instructions, and refund guidance.
siteText.beforeText: Use this as a quick reference only. Confirm the policy in the airline's live agency portal, especially for refunds, codeshares, other-airline ticket stock, NDC bookings, active waivers, and travel within 72 hours.
siteText.placeholder: Airline information will appear here after you make a selection.
siteText.feedback: If you notice any incorrect information, or if an airline has updated their policies, please contact AJ with updates or suggestions.
siteText.footer: Last cross-checked against publicly available official airline and travel-agent guidance: September 14, 2026. Internal reference guide only. Airline policies and waiver codes may change without notice. Verify the live airline agency portal, validating carrier, ticket stock, and waiver instructions before processing.
